meta.title: Condicionales
meta.goal: Expresa hipótesis complejas mediante condicionales omitidas e invertidas ('Had I known', 'Were it not for', 'If need be', 'If so/not').

cards.title: Condicionales: qué expresa
cards.lede: Expresa hipótesis complejas mediante condicionales omitidas e invertidas ('Had I known', 'Were it not for', 'If need be', 'If so/not').

rows.value: Had we anticipated the demand, we would have doubled production.
Were the manager to resign, the department would collapse.
Were it not for / But for your intervention, we would have failed.
We can deploy additional servers if need be.

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer el patrón y usarlo en frases propias.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la estructura completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

rows.value: Had + sujeto + participio pasado, sujeto + would have + participio · Had I known, I would have acted.
Were + sujeto + to + verbo base, sujeto + would + verbo base · Were you to ask, I would assist.
Are there any updates? If so, notify the team immediately.

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo en situaciones reales del día a día.

rows.value: Had the warning systems functioned properly, the disaster would have been averted.
Were competitors to lower their prices, we would respond with value-added services.
But for the legal team's quick response, the firm would have faced heavy fines.
Check whether the system is responsive. If not, initiate a manual reboot.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: Compara estas opciones para saber cuándo elegir cada una.

columns.label: Inversión condicional (C2)
columns.rule: Elimina la conjunción 'if' invirtiendo el auxiliar 'Had' o 'Were' al inicio de la cláusula
examples: Had I received the report, I would have reviewed it.

columns.label: Condicional estándar con If (B2)
columns.rule: Mantiene la conjunción 'if' y el orden estándar de sujeto + verbo
examples: If I had received the report, I would have reviewed it.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con la forma natural en inglés.

lines.text: If had I known about the defect, I wouldn't have approved it.
Had I known about the defect, I wouldn't have approved it.
lines.note: Al invertir el verbo ('Had I known'), la conjunción 'if' debe eliminarse completamente.

cards.title: Guía rápida de uso
cards.lede: Comprueba las reglas clave para este patrón.

rows.value: NUNCA uses 'if' junto a la inversión (ej. 'If had I known' es incorrecto).

rows.key: 2. 'Were it not for' = sin tu ayuda
rows.value: Expresa que una circunstancia presente es el único obstáculo o razón.
Es la versión pasada de la exclusión ('Had it not been for your help...').
Usa 'if need be' (si es necesario), 'if any' (si los hay), 'if so' (si es así).

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: escribe una frase personal con el patrón.

quiz.q: ___ it not for your strategic guidance, the project would have run out of funds.
quiz.explain: 'Were it not for' equivale a 'si no fuera por tu orientación estratégica'.

quiz.q: ___ we to encounter technical difficulties, our support desk will assist you.
quiz.explain: 'Were + sujeto + to + infinitivo' es la forma invertida del segundo condicional.

quiz.q: Please verify if the documents require notarization. ___, send them to legal.
quiz.explain: 'If so' reemplaza elípticamente a la afirmación 'if they require notarization'.
